instructions: Add one confirmed row per concrete evidence item. Cite canonical source files, copy verifier excerpts verbatim, and judge source presence separately from recovery.

criteria.criterion: Access OpenStreetMap search for 'British Museum, London'
criteria.description: Navigate to OpenStreetMap and attempt to use its search (e.g., the provided starting URL) for 'British Museum, London'. Full credit if the agent reaches OSM search or clearly reports a blocker such as CAPTCHA, downtime, network errors, or content not loading. Partial credit if the agent uses an unclear/non-OSM method without first attempting OSM.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot 1 shows the OpenStreetMap Search Results panel with the query field containing “British Museum, London” and a matching result listed. Screenshot 2 also shows the search box still containing “British Museum, London”. Latest relevant: Screenshot 2.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Evidence clearly confirms OSM search was accessed and the intended query was used. No adjustment needed.

A “More results” button is shown.

evidence_analyses.discrepancies: None for this criterion; the screenshot clearly shows the OSM search UI and the query/result for British Museum in London.

criteria.criterion: Navigate to the exact British Museum OSM object page
criteria.description: From OSM search results (or map selection), open the matching object page for the British Museum on Great Russell Street in London (not another similarly named result). Full credit if the correct object page is opened. Partial credit if the agent finds the museum but opens an ambiguous/nearby/related feature (e.g., entrance, stop, perimeter sub-feature) or does not open the object page. Full credit if the agent documents that no exact/unique match is available in results or that search results are incomplete/buggy, despite reasonable attempts (e.g., trying alternate queries, map click selection).

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot 2 shows the object details sidebar titled “Relation: British Museum (177044)” and address tags including Great Russell Street, London, WC1B 3DG, indicating the correct British Museum object on Great Russell Street. Latest relevant: Screenshot 2.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: The exact British Museum object page (relation 177044) is open; this satisfies the constraint to select the Great Russell Street museum, not a similarly named result. Keep full credit.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: Left sidebar shows an object page titled “Relation: British Museum (177044)” with “Version #78”. The map highlights a large outlined complex labeled “British Museum” near “Great Russell Street”. The tags table shows “addr:street Great Russell Street”, “addr:city London”, and “addr:postcode WC1B 3DG”.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: Full credit: the screenshot clearly shows the British Museum object page for a relation with ID 177044 and the address on Great Russell Street in London, matching the required object.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: No clear mismatch: the agent’s claim that they opened the British Museum relation page aligns with the visible “Relation: British Museum (177044)” and address tags.

dom_model_context.verifier_justification: DOM confirms navigation to the exact British Museum object page (relation 177044) corresponding to the Great Russell Street London result. Full credit.

criteria.criterion: Respect constraints (no sign-in/edit; stop after recording requested info)
criteria.description: Agent does not sign in or attempt to edit OpenStreetMap, and stops once the exact British Museum object plus all requested identifiers and tag values (or explicit unavailability) are recorded. Full credit if constraints are followed. Partial credit if minor unnecessary browsing occurs without violating sign-in/edit constraints.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshots show the OSM header with “Log In”/“Sign Up” (not signed in) and a read-only object page sidebar; no editing workflow is shown. Latest relevant: Screenshot 2.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: No evidence of signing in or editing. The agent did stop after presenting an answer; however, it did not correctly handle unverified tags (tourism/museum/website). This does not violate the no-edit/no-login constraint, but it does mean they effectively ‘stopped’ without reliably recording all requested tag values. Minor deduction is appropriate rather than full loss because the constraint focus is primarily no sign-in/edit.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The top right shows “Log In” and “Sign Up” buttons, indicating the user is not signed in. There is an “Edit” button near the top (standard OSM UI), but no edit mode, no editor screen, and no sign-in flow is shown in the screenshot.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The screenshot provides no evidence of signing in or editing, so the ‘no sign-in/edit’ portion appears respected. However, the agent’s predicted output claims they already opened the relation object page and extracted multiple tags; that is not shown here, suggesting the ‘stop after recording requested info’ claim is not supported by this screenshot (they appear to still be on search results). Partial support only.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Agent states they reached relation/177044 and recorded all requested tags; screenshot instead shows the search results panel and map view, not the object page with tags.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: Top-right shows “Log In” and “Sign Up” buttons; there is no indication of being signed in. No editing UI is shown beyond the standard “Edit” menu in the OSM header; the sidebar is an object view with tags, not an edit form.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: Full credit: nothing in the screenshot suggests the agent signed in or attempted to edit. The agent’s predicted output indicates they stopped after recording requested info (though some reported tags aren’t visible here).
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: No evidence of sign-in/editing in the screenshot. However, the agent’s claimed completion includes tag values (tourism/museum/website) not visible here; that affects criteria 6–8 rather than the no-edit constraint itself.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: DOM-model state 1 shows a read-only object page with Log In/Sign Up and no evidence of entering edit mode; action history shows only a click from search results to the object page.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: No sign-in/edit actions are evidenced, and the agent stopped after reporting info. Full credit.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 1 shows read-only controls including "Log In" and "Sign Up" and no evidence of entering edit mode. Action history shows only a single left_click on a search-result link leading to the relation page; no further navigation or editing actions are recorded.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: EVIDENCE_STATUS: SUPPORTED
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: None observed in the provided history/DOM. (Note: whether the agent 'stopped' is inferred from the single action and final state; no DOM evidence of additional browsing is present.)
